title: Koutoubia Mosque, Marrakesh
summary: The Koutoubia Mosque in Marrakesh was raised in 1147-1158 by Abd el Mou'men on the site of earlier foundations. UNESCO describes its 77 m minaret as matchless, an essential monument of Muslim architecture and a landmark and symbol of the city.

uncertainty.note: ICOMOS gives 1147-1158 for the building of the mosque by Abd el Mou'men; the end is the present, as the mosque and minaret still stand.

where.historical_name: Koutoubia mosque, Marrakesh, built under Abd el Mou'men

importance.justification: UNESCO names the Koutoubia's 77 m minaret as an essential monument of Muslim architecture and the symbol of Marrakesh.

reviewer_note: Outline only; no model written. The 77 m minaret height is in the UNESCO and ICOMOS texts, but no plan dimension for the minaret was found on a page that could be opened: a search snippet from Archnet gave 'almost 13 m' per side, but Archnet blocked the fetch (HTTP 429 and a bot check), and a travel listing's 12.8 m was not on the page when opened. The ICOMOS text is French with OCR errors; the 1147-1158 span is read from it and the spotcheck regex matches '1147-1158'. The sources opened do not give a finish date for the minaret.
